entries.title: Nonequilibrium assembly and mechanics of a coarse-grained collagen IV network
entries.author: Meadowcroft, and others
entries.note: Two-bead-rod + stochastic NC1/7S crosslink model that viva-lumenoid v1 is built from. Deck not in hand; parameters transcribed from the AICS spec sheet.

entries.title: Basement-membrane growth under fixed stress
entries.author: Barrientos, and others
entries.note: Grows the network at fixed stress and reads off growth rate; stage 2 inverts this to impose an equibiaxial strain rate and read the stress.

entries.title: Nanoscale topography of the basement membrane underlying the corneal epithelium of the rhesus macaque
entries.author: Abrams, Gretchen A. and Goodman, Sara L. and Nealey, Paul F. and Franco, Marco and Murphy, Christopher J.
entries.note: Low-voltage SEM: mean pore diameter 72 +/- 40 nm, fibre diameter 77 +/- 44 nm on the exposed BM face.

entries.title: Targeted analysis of the collagen IV network reveals laterally bundled strands in cell-deposited basement membrane
entries.author: Pokidysheva, Elena and others
entries.note: Immuno-gold SEM of PFHR-9 scaffold: 5 to 7 protomers associate laterally into each strand.

entries.title: Sequence-dependent mechanics of the collagen IV triple helix
entries.author: Alshaer, Walhan and others
entries.note: Single-molecule AFM (n=262): contour length 360 +/- 20 nm, net persistence length 39 +/- 2 nm.

entries.author: Timpl, Rupert and Wiedemann, Heinz and van Delden, Volkmar and Furthmayr, Heinz and K\"uhn, Klaus, title = A network model for the organization of type IV collagen molecules in basement membranes, journal = European Journal of Biochemistry, volume = 120, pages = 203--211, year = 1981, note = Rotary-shadowing EM: triple-helical strand 355 +/- 4.9 nm; NC1 globule 12.5 nm; 7S segment 30 nm.

entries.title: Fine structure of the glomerular basement membrane of the rat observed by high-resolution scanning electron microscopy
entries.author: Shirato, Ichiei and Tomino, Yasuhiko and Koide, Hikaru and Sakai, Toshiyuki
entries.note: Individual collagen IV fibrils 5-9 nm (lamina rara interna) and 6-11 nm (lamina rara externa).

entries.title: Nanoscale topography and stiffness of the basement membrane of a mammary acinus
entries.author: Fabris, Gloria and others
entries.note: AFM nanoindentation: shear modulus 1025 +/- 496 Pa for an MCF10A acinus BM.

entries.title: Nonlinear mechanics of the tumour spheroid basement membrane by micro-inflation
entries.author: Li, Lu and others
entries.note: Micro-inflation: effective modulus ~82 kPa for an MDA-MB-231 spheroid BM.
